---
title: "Blog"
description: "Blog posts by William E. Echeverría Tigse."
# Keep the description as metadata only (see the hide-description rule in styles.scss).
# Individual posts don't use this class, so their descriptions show under the post title.
body-classes: hide-description
listing:
  contents: "posts/*/index.qmd"
  sort: "date desc"
  type: default
  fields: [date, title, description]
  date-format: "D MMMM YYYY"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
language:
  listing-page-no-matches: "No posts yet. Posts are coming soon."
---
